name: Naíonra
summary:
For the first time in Ireland, we get a fly-on-the-wall insight into a small world where big things happen – welcome to the wonderful world of the Naíonra. In this heartwarming three-part series, cameras follow all the action in two Naíonra over the course of one year, one in Tallaght, Dublin, and one in Mallow, County Cork. 

Máire Uí Bhriain is the director of Naíonra Thomáis Dáibhís in Mallow, and she relishes connecting with the children by connecting with her own inner child. In Tallaght, Aisling Breathnach is director of Naíonra Chaitlín Maude and she loves the honesty of the kids and how they make her laugh.

These two Naíonraí are not in a Gaeltacht and most of these children start with no Irish, but their parents want to offer them the gift of Gaeilge… and in the Naíonra we see their first steps in becoming fluent in a second language. 

As we observe the children, experts enrich our understanding of their early experiences. Speech & Language Therapist Dr. Ciara O'Toole explains throughout the series how we acquire language and how the brain is wired to learn multiple languages from birth. 

But these early learners aren't just learning a second language. This is a period in childhood development where the brain is exploding with activity as it develops hugely, as Clinical Psychologist Dr. Cáit Verling explains. 

Education expert An tOllamh Emeritus Pádraig Ó Duibhir gives context to the experience of the children and their teachers as we join them on this journey in one of the most important years in life, where so many of the skills we use throughout our lives are first learned - understanding, communication and friendship.

name: Scéalta ár Stampaí
summary: Scéalta ár Stampaí is a six-part series telling rich stories of Irish culture and history in a completely novel way, through the wonderful images seen on our postage stamps through the decades. This beautiful and original 6-part series reveals the big stories told within the tiny frame of a stamp!

name: Hector Caribbean
summary: Join Hector as he embarks on an action-packed journey across the Caribbean, visiting everything from a cigar factory in Cuba, to the carnival in Kingston, Jamaica and even stopping off in the Caribbean's very own Emerald Isle of Montserrat.

name: Go Tóin Poill
summary: Go Tóin Poill is a sketch show like no other. In these hilarious, short episodes, we take a look at the lives fish lead when humans aren't looking.

name: Fast Friends
summary: Celebrating 30 years of Friends, this four-part game show tests contestants with trivia and puzzles while re-living fan favorite moments.

name: Sean's Show
summary: Comedian Sean Hughes is plucked from obscurity and trapped in a TV reconstruction of his Muswell Hill flat, where his everyday bumblings are exposed to the gaze of a studio audience.

name: Conas?
summary: Have you ever wondered how products we use from day to day are made? CONAS goes behind the scenes at factories all over the country, where we explore how a specific product is made each week. Each week two new young presenters follow the manufacturing process of a different product from start to finish right up until we see it on the shop shelf. From Foods, like Bread, Milk, and Honey to products like candles, sports jerseys, Hurleys and even Fire Engines - we find out HOW THEY ARE MADE.

name: Mo Shaol Do Shaol
summary: Mo Shaol Do Shaol is back on Cúla4 with a new series in which two people who are completely different from each other exchange hobbies and lives for one day. They will also have a big challenge to achieve before the end of the day. In Series 3, the children will not only be swapping hobbies, but their lifestyles as well! There's a huge variety this series - horse riding, orienteering, aerial circus, water polo and much more.

name: Breath of Fire
summary: In 2013, Katie Griggs, a millennial YouTube astrologer, rose to fame as the face of Kundalini yoga, opening the RA MA Institute in Los Angeles, donning a white turban, and reinventing herself as Guru Jagat. Breath of Fire explores Guru Jagat's evolution while chronicling the shocking secret history of Kundalini through its origins in the 1960s to its expansion in the United States and its presence in wellness circles today. Based on the Vanity Fair story by Hayley Phelan, "The Second Coming of Guru Jagat," Breath of Fire illuminates the culture of modern spirituality revealing complicated themes of cultural appropriation and the dangers of self-proclaimed gurus.

name: Nuacht Cúla4
summary: News programme for young people covering local, national and international news.

name: Lí Ban
summary:
Fantastical heroes, legendary villains and a reality that bends around Celtic magic are at the heart of the adventures of sassy 12-year-old Lí Ban. The tales are some of the wildest ever passed down the Celtic generations. With origins as old as the lands and shores that shaped it, each incredible episode brings some answers, but even more questions, as Lí Ban's quest unfolds. 

Transformed into a Mermaid and a Sea Otter, Lí Ban and her faithful dog Con spend centuries scouring the watery kingdoms of Celtic legend meeting gods, monsters, giants and wily humans as they search for answers.

Who destroyed her homeplace? Why was she transformed? And who is she really? Theirs is an immortal quest through the heart of an ancient Celtic universe into the stories of a time and place (almost) forgotten.

Lí Ban seeks answers. Her quest leads her to Manannán the sea god but as answers materialise more questions arise. Hers is a journey from childish rebel to courageous adolescent through the growth that shows her what the real meaning of family is and what it means to be Lí Ban.

name: Is Mise
summary: A new season of the inventive series follows four young presenters as they discover the world around them. Through the eyes of Sibéal, Seoirse, Síofra and Cian we learn and explore the local world. The presenters, on their various adventures, encourage young viewers to be curious about their own world and explore new experiences.

name: Backs to the Land
summary: Backs to the Land starts in 1940 with three young women who are in the Women's Land Army going to work in a farm to replace the men who have gone to war. The three women are Daphne, Cockney Jenny and Jewish, down to earth Shirley. They end up at Crabtree Farm in Clayfield, Norfolk. The owner is Tom Whitlow, and his sons are Roy and Eric.

name: TrueSouth
summary: TrueSouth tells honest stories about the past, present, and future of the South. In each city, we focus on two restaurants that talk to each other in interesting ways. From barbecue joints to gas station ceviche cafes, we share the origins of these restaurants, the forces threatening them, and the belief systems that support them.

name: Built America Presents
summary: Offering viewers an insightful look into the incredible feats of engineering that have shaped the nation. This series focuses on the stories behind some of America's most iconic structures and the innovative minds that brought them to life.

name: Karadut
summary: Zuhal Erdem is a woman at the peak of her career as a personal development specialist. She has achieved success by providing consultancy on love and relationships. However, she lives a completely different life in the house she lives with her family. After losing her mother at a young age, she devoted herself to her father and three sisters. After years of loneliness, she meets Tayfun thanks to her assistant Eylem and faces great difficulties for the sake of this relationship. She will oppose her father Çetin and embark on a journey full of love and disappointments.

name: Iron Family
summary:
Cheongryeom Laundry has been run by Lee Da-Rim's family for 3 generations. Her family has enough money that they can iron out their dreams instead of being worried. Seo Kang-Joo is the son of the wealthiest family in the Cheongryeom neighborhood. He works as a senior director of the Jiseung Group. 8 years ago, Seo Kang-Joo and Lee Da-Rim attended the same university. Prior to enlisting in the military, he had an unforgettable experience with Lee Da-Rim.

Now, Seo Kang-Joo reunites with Lee Da-Rim and gets involved with her. Since she was in her teens, Lee Da-Rim's eyesight has deteriorated and she had limited vision. After turning 30 years old, Lee Da-Rim completely lost her vision, but there is hope that she will be able to see again. An injection that is extremely expensive may give her vision back.

name: Geordie Stories: Charlotte's New Baby
summary:
Geordie Stories: Charlotte's New Baby will follow Television Royalty Charlotte Crosby as she and her fiancé Jake Ankers prepare for the arrival of their second child. Fans have followed Charlotte at every stage of her young adult life, and this series will give viewers a glimpse into her favourite role yet – being a mother!

This series will take fans behind the scenes as the clock ticks down to Charlotte and Jake's daughter Alba getting a sibling. With a slammed schedule, the parenting pressures and juggle has never been busier. Fresh from landing her dream job as the boss in the upcoming Aussie Shore, we will watch Charlotte balance her glamorous work and energetic life filter free as she goes from bump to birth. Viewers will even get to see some familiar Geordie faces along the way as well as fan favourites Letitia and Gary Crosby and dogs Baby, Rhubarb and Banana, who have now moved into Charlotte and Jake's house while their house is being renovated!

name: A Virtuous Business
summary: In search of purpose, opportunity and independence, four rural women start an adult products business in 1992 — embarking on a journey of self-discovery.

name: FACEOFF: Inside the NHL
summary: FACEOFF: Inside the NHL gives an unprecedented, unfiltered look into the lives of the greatest hockey players in the NHL chasing the hardest trophy to win in sports: the Stanley Cup.

name: Our Oceans
summary: Dive into Our Oceans, a thrilling five-episode series, narrated by Barack Obama, that invites you to join Emmy winning wildlife filmmaker James Honeyborne on an awe-inspiring adventure. This groundbreaking show will whisk you away on a global journey, uncovering the mesmerizing stories of our planet's five majestic oceans. Each episode delves into the unique characters of the creatures within these ecosystems, from playful and cunning to resilient and mysterious. Ride along the world's great current as we reveal nature's most spectacular aquatic personalities and breathtaking wonders.

name: This is the Zodiac Speaking
summary: In this true-crime docuseries, a family searching for answers shares clues and eye-opening testimonies about the prime suspect in the Zodiac murders.

name: Frifot
summary: The stilettos are parked - now Anne wants to go on an adventure! With forest and fjord as a place to romp, she creates rich days out for herself and her travel companions.

name: The Dog Down Under
summary:
The Dog Down Under calls on Australians to enter their dog, or a dog they know, into one or more of five competition categories: Most Talented, Sportiest, Heroic , Oldest, and the Hardest Working pooches for the chance to win the Top Dog prize in each category.

More than just a competition, The Dog Down Under is a 5-part TV series hosted by Lara Shannon sharing the entertaining and heart-warming stories of the Finalists and Winners .

name: Serial Killer Capital: Los Angeles
summary: From 1984 to 2007, nearly 50 women are assaulted and murdered in a small area of Los Angeles. After first hunting a serial killer dubbed the Southside Slayer, investigators ultimately discover that they're chasing not one, but four brutal murderers.

name: The Great Outdoors
summary:
The Seven Network today announced the return of The Great Outdoors, with a reimagined version of the much-loved series set to showcase the best of Australian and international travel. 

Set to premiere at 7.00pm on Saturday, 5 October on Channel 7 and 7plus, The Great Outdoors taps the nation's enduring wanderlust, with new presenters James Tobin, Phil Burton, Teigan Nash, Kimberley Busteed, Lee Carseldine and Chris Parsons offering a glimpse into the world's most unique experiences from our own backyard and across the world. 

The Great Outdoors team will scour the globe to bring viewers extraordinary and unmissable adventures, epic scenery and vibrant food and culture.

Travel with the team as they visit all four corners of the compass in Australia, from diving off the Western Australian coast to trekking the deep forests of Tasmania; hop in the passenger seat on a classic convertible road trip along the iconic Route 66 in the US; and scale the snow-covered heights of northern Europe.

name: Philly Homicide
summary:
Born and raised in the City of Brotherly Love, Lt. Chris McMullin (Bucks County Sheriff's Office) hosts "Philly Homicide." McMullin spent several years as a Philadelphia P.D. patrol officer before working his way up to become a detective with Bensalem P.D., where he investigated everything from robberies to assaults, sex crimes and homicides.  

In each hourlong episode of "Philly Homicide," McMullin gives unique insights on crimes that took place in a region steeped in rich history, vibrant culture, and known for tenacity and grit. Archival footage, exclusive first-person interviews with former and current Philly area detectives and cinematic recreations provide an insider's view into the heartrending cases Philly's finest diligently worked to solve in the city known as America's birthplace.

name: A Plan to Kill
summary: A Plan to Kill is a true-crime series that examines the story of sadistic and meticulous killers who plan their victims' murders for weeks, months or even years. Each stand-alone episode is brought to life through a tapestry of firsthand interviews with investigators and those close to the victim. Over the course of the hour, we'll follow detectives on a winding investigation. They'll work through dead ends, red herrings and misdirects planted by the killer to throw them off... all in their quest to identify the guilty party and bring them to justice.

name: Yama utfordrer
summary: Yama Wolasmal meets powerful people face to face. He confronts them with decisions that have had a major impact on millions of people.

name: Phillip Schofield Cast Away
summary:
Phillip Schofield has graced our screens for over 40 years. He has faced countless daunting experiences throughout his career but none more demanding than being cast away for ten days on a tropical island, 50 kilometres off the northern coast of Madagascar.

After a training day with a survival expert, Phillip takes his final boat ride to the island, where he'll be utterly alone and filming himself with no crew - forced to reckon with both the unforgiving environment and effects of total isolation. Landing on the island's beach, he is excited and optimistic about the challenge ahead. But with gale force winds ripping into his camp in the middle of the night, he soon realises this might be harder than expected.

As the days pass Phillip is left to navigate his new island home alone, attempting to scavenge for mangoes, find a water source and catch fish. His time alone offers him opportunities to reflect on some of the tougher times in his life.

After days without any meaningful food, he desperately ventures into the jungle at dusk in hopes of catching a crab for dinner. But as the dark sets in he finds himself lost in the dense jungle with only a headlamp and no idea of how to get back to camp. Disorientated and alone, panic starts to set in.

name: Mancave
summary: An honest and raw renovation program about friendship, crew and banality, where Norwegian men get their finger out and build the boyhood dream.

previousepisode.name: Grillfest og Sex on the beach

name: Sau
summary: A daughter will take over a small farm in Nordland. Warm and intimate documentary about family, traditions and finding one's own way. And about sheep.

name: All Up in My Grill
summary: Top Chef alum Dale Talde is back to fire up another batch of innovative and flavorful grilling recipes, served with tips and techniques that will unlock your cookout potential and will make your backyard barbecues legendary.

name: Open Mic
summary: Open Mic is 10 programs with performances by almost 70 participants from different regions of Russia. These comedians were selected based on the results of the Big Standup Fest VK, which took place in May 2023. At the end of each Open Mic episode, the jury together with the host determines the funniest. These participants become participants in the new show from VK - Money Mic, the broadcasts of which start immediately after the release of Open Mic.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск 10 | Дорохов х Бебуришвили х Амарян х Артюхов

name: I tourta tis mamas
summary: A special comedy series set against dinners, birthdays, wedding anniversaries, christenings, funerals and celebrations, with guests coming together to get to know each other, to reminisce, to argue, but most of all to spread a lot of laughter. So, when food ceases to be just a way of culinary pleasure and becomes a sweet occasion for company, love and security, that's the moment "Mum's Cake" arrives at the table". This cake made by a plain, everyday, ordinary mum, Kaiti Konstantinou, who has set out to become famous over the internet, has a magical power. It soothes everything that distresses us, stresses us or puts us in a tough spot, it makes us let it all go and smile again as we did when we were children.

name: Mama Cake
summary: María is a senior lady who decides to reopen her business, the Mamá Cake bakery, with the difference that she will now add a special touch to the cakes and pastries. Her success and the circumstances will lead to problems with the police and Hans, the local drug dealer. María now risks losing her business, her grandson, and even her life.

name: Money Mic
summary: Comedians from the Open Mic project compete with experienced comedians for real money! The best in the episode will receive 100,000 rubles, and will also go to Big Money Mic, where 1 million rubles will be raffled off.

previousepisode.name: BIG MONEY MIC 2 | Мягкова х Абрамов х Бебуришвили х Амарян

name: Billy Liar
summary: Billy Fisher gets lost in his imagination in order to escape from the drudgery of everyday life.

name: Where I Found You
summary: A story about how long distance relationship can test us through time and trials!

name: Heima er best
summary: After the banking crisis the travel industry became a desirable goldmine in Iceland. When three very different, middle-aged siblings inherit the successful whale watching company and the beautiful summerhouse their parents built, things become extremely difficult. To take joint decisions about the legacy they all feel entitled to creates complex circumstances, and when they start to manipulate what they are to share, old wounds open up with dire consequences.

name: Comedy Revenge
summary: Comedy icons, from YouTube stars to TV veterans, gather in the ultimate competition of laughter — to be crowned the winner by the legend, Lee Kyeong-kyu.

name: Live and Let Dai
summary:
Dai Henwood is one of New Zealand's most-loved comedians and broadcasters who has graced Kiwi TV screens for more than two decades.

A two-time winner of the prestigious Fred Award, Dai is known for his quick wit, strong stage presence, and ability to connect with his audience which has made him a beloved figure in New Zealand entertainment.

Every day, thousands of New Zealanders wake up to face a brutal battle against cancer – and among them is Dai Henwood, who was diagnosed with incurable bowel cancer three years ago. The diagnosis has set forth a journey that has and continues to test him mentally, physically, and spiritually.

The three-part series documents Dai's courageous fight against cancer, offering an insight into his life since his diagnosis. From the initial shock of finding out, and the demanding realities of treatment, to moments of peace and healing, Dai shares his experiences in a heart-wrenching yet inspiring way.

name: The Rise of Zhao Jiadi
summary: Zhao Jiadi, the inheritor of Jinhai Group, cannot stand his father's tyrannical ways. He gave up a guaranteed place at the top universities and chose to attend a third-rate college instead. He even made a million-yuan bet, vowing to build a business empire of his own! However, his success soon attracted the retaliation of his rival, Chen Hongxiong. Unbeknownst to anyone, a fierce business war is brewing...

name: The Heir's Forbidden Love
summary: Gu An'an, the heiress of the Gu Group, faces a sudden family crisis when her mother mysteriously falls off a cliff and slips into a coma. Meanwhile, her gambling-addicted father, Ye Tingfeng, schemes to seize the entire family fortune. To protect her family's assets, Gu An'an decides to marry the eldest son of the Huo family, Huo Siwen. However, she meets the overlooked second son, Huo Siting, and the two form an alliance. As they navigate the complexities of their situation, a forbidden romance quietly blossoms within the lavish halls of the wealthy family…

name: Dual Love
summary: The "martial arts alliance's leader" Xie Mingyuan plans to marry his only daughter Xie Tianba, the "number one beauty of the martial world," to Ningyuan Marquis, the "dynasty's biggest traitor," as a concubine. In a fit of anger, Xie Tianba leaves her home at Mount Yanhua for the first time to survive in the martial world, which she knows nothing about. She runs into Storm Sect's leader Mo Haoran, who saves her from a predicament. Xie Tianba, who carries on the legacy of her mother from Medicinal Sect, immediately detects the strange poison Jialanxiang in Mo Haoran's body. Out of gratitude and pity, she repeatedly relieves him of his poison pains, and the two slowly fall in love. When the righteous sects gather to suppress the evil sect, Xie Tianba realizes her father is actually the so-called unparalleled villain: the evil sect's leader! To protect Mount Yanhua, Xie Tianba hangs around the martial arts alliance to gather intel. But Mo Haoran makes use of her trust to trick her into leading the righteous sects to attack Mount Yanhua. Xie Tianba would rather die than surrender, and exhausts her powers to protect her juniors, while Mo Haoran fights desperately to save her. Xie Mingyuan, who has evacuated early, tells Xie Tianba that Mo Haoran is Shen Wugui, the Ningyuan Marquis. Five years ago, to save the 13-year-old young emperor, Ningyuan Marquis was poisoned with Jialanxiang. His powerful uncle also recruited righteous sects to form the "Blood Buddha" to assassinate loyal courtiers. Thus, Ningyuan Marquis changed his name to Mo Haoran and teamed up with the "evil sect's leader" Xie Mingyuan along with Storm Sect to set the stage. Ultimately, he defeats the sects behind the "Blood Buddha". Peace is restored in the martial world and the government, and Ningyuan Marquis dies of poisoning despite his outstanding achievements; However, Storm Sect's leader Mo Haoran is saved by Medicinal Sect's descendant, and the two of them live happily ever after.

name: The Fight Life
summary: The Fight Life chronicles a year in the world of Top Rank boxing through the journeys of five of the sport's elite boxers  — Tyson Fury, Naoya Inoue, Seniesa Estrada, Teofimo Lopez, and Josh Taylor — alongside unprecedented and exclusive behind-the-scenes access with Top Rank's executives. As the boxers prepare for some of the biggest fights of their careers, episodes document the traveling circus that is the business of the sport, offering a living, breathing, punching, 360-degree portrait of "the fight life."

name: Waterfront Beat
summary: A drama series about a newly-established police division on a dockland waterfront.

name: The Source Of River
summary: Years after a personal and professional setback, tax investigator Zheng Hao is assigned to expose a major tax evasion network in Xindong. As his former fiancée, Liang Jinqiu, returns from abroad and their old friend, Professor Zhao Mingda, faces a family crisis, they become entangled in a dangerous fight against corruption and deception hidden beneath the city's facade.

name: Grand Designs Suomi
summary: Under the leadership of architect Samppa Lappalainen, we follow the passion projects of house builders from the beginning, from the design table through construction stages and challenges to the finished dream home. Where did the old dreams start and what kind of work must be done to fulfill the dreams? And was all the hard work worth it?

name: Time of My Life
summary:
Ken Archer, 49 years old, has been with the same firm for 33 years but has just been told he is to be made redundant. On the same evening his wife tells him that she is leaving him for a man 20 years her junior!

His two sons are no help in his time of crisis and, after contemplating suicide, he decides to make the best of it. But Ken's luck has run out and things get a lot worse as a series of disasters befall him.

name: Das Duell um die Geld
summary:
Joko and Klaas go all-in and invite good friends to a "duel for the money" for the money. Quiz meets poker at the big game night. Knowledge meets bluffing. 
Absolute cluelessness meets big winnings. In keeping with the occasion 
quiz questions are posed in a stylish ambience and the correct The correct answer is then played at the gaming table. Who can shine with knowledge shine? Who can bankrupt themselves? Who will bluff their way to victory?

previousepisode.name: Anna Dushime, Kida Ramadan, Louis Klamroth, Joko und Klaas zocken um Bares

nextepisode.name: Bastian Pastewka, Taneshia Abt und Wincent Weiss

name: SEKOTENGS
summary: Four young and handsome doctors undergo their clinical internship at a hospital and realize that their chosen profession is filled with challenges.

name: Mäklarna i Marbella
summary: The Swedish agents at the luxury real estate firm Homerun Brokers compete for the best listings in Spain's high-end holiday destination Marbella.

name: The Manhattan Alien Abduction
summary: A woman claims to have been abducted from her bedroom in Manhattan. This docuseries explores whether it was an elaborate hoax — or proof of alien life.

name: Y llegaron de noche
summary: Inspired by true events, Y llegaron de noche is a workplace comedy series about the underdogs who accidentally made the best Dracula movie you've never seen—the Spanish version of the 1931 classic. While Bela Lugosi filmed by day, a separate cast and crew arrived at night to shoot the same movie in Spanish, using the same sets, costumes, and a translated script. Working from dusk till dawn, they defied the odds and created a superior version to the original.

name: It's All Country
summary: Behind every country song is an untold story. Country music super star Luke Bryan is exploring the hidden depths of Nashville in search of those stories. The series features never-before-seen performances by some of the biggest stars of country music as Luke uncovers the secrets, the hidden inspirations and the personal moments that shaped the music you love.

name: Countdown: Paul vs. Tyson
summary: One epic bout. Two fearless boxers. Months of intense training. In this all-access docuseries, Jake Paul and Mike Tyson gear up for the fight of the year.

name: Lalola
summary:
Lalo's life changes after breaking Romina's heart and waking up as Lola. She must learn to be a woman with all her disadvantages in a macho world as she seeks to reverse the spell.

As revealed at the end of season 1, Lola is pregnant. As season 2 begins, we try to find out how this happened. We learn about her attempts to find true love, which man or woman she was involved with, how she tried to bribe Circe to break the curse, if only for 24 hours, and everything she did to undo the spell.

name: Algo Personal con Jorge Ramos
summary: A series of conversations between Jorge Ramos and some of the most recognized Spanish-speaking celebrities. Fascinating characters share their most intimate and personal side; their successes and sorrows, their fears and desires, and their best kept secrets.

name: Destination 2024 Presidential Forums
summary: Univision News presents two Destination 2024 presidential forums with Republican nominee Donald Trump and Democratic nominee Kamala Harris. Each nominee will interact with undecided Hispanic voters and answer their questions. The special "Latinos Ask ... Donald Trump Responds" will air on Tuesday, October 8 at 10 p.m. ET from Miami, Fla. "Latinos Ask ... Kamala Harris Responds" will air Thursday, Oct. 10 at 10 p.m. ET from Las Vegas, Nev. Both events will be broadcast coast-to-coast with Spanish translation.

name: Lost and Found
summary: Si Qingye, the president of Si Group, and Ning Wuhui had a misunderstanding due to a villain's scheme and parted on bad terms. Later, Ning Wuhui, who was pregnant, unexpectedly lost her memory. She gave birth to a child and became a single mother. Seven years later, they reunited, gradually got to know and love each other again, resolved their misunderstanding, and began a happy life as a family of four.

name: Otto no Katei wo Kowasu made
summary: Kisaragi Minori, who thought she had a happy family with her pure love since they were students and was married to her husband Yudai, was blessed with children, but the story begins when she finds out that her husband Yudai has been cheating on her for 15 years. Minori, who has vowed to take revenge on Yudai, who has another family, and on his lover, Riko Miyake, plots her revenge using Riko's son, Wataru.

name: Rigo
summary: This series is inspired by an athlete predestined to mark an era, born to be an idol and committed to a prophecy that his father made: "my son is going to be known all over the world." Rigo is an optimist by conviction, a comedian and a talker by nature, and that is the spirit of the story based on him and his three great loves: the father who takes violence away from him; Michelle, the woman he has longed for since he was a child; and the bicycle that accompanies him to sell lottery tickets in his town and then takes him to the top of the world.

name: Love Is Blind Habibi
summary: Celebrity couple Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali host this social experiment, where Arab singles connect and commit to marriage — before meeting face-to-face.

name: Psykodrama
summary: With mental health as the setting, we join actors Per and Olec on a fun journey through the fight against themselves – and their surroundings.

previousepisode.name: Når enden er god, kan alt bare bli verre

name: Au cœur des Jeux
summary: At the Heart of the Games, taking viewers behind the scenes of the organization of the biggest event in the world.

name: Look at It This Way
summary: A satirical portrait of London adapted by Justin Cartwright from his own novel of London life.

name: Doubt
summary: Jang Tae Su is a legendary criminal profiler in Korea. He was one of the first in his field and paved the way for criminal behavior analysts in the country. He has gained the absolute respect and trust within the police organization. At home, he is a single parent and raises his daughter by himself. Jang Tae Su works on a murder case and realizes that his daughter is involved in the case. The discovery shakes everything in his professional beliefs and his relationship with his daughter. To protect his daughter, Jang Tae Su struggles to reveal the truth.

name: Schiphol Airport
summary: Schiphol opens its doors for a unique look behind the scenes of the largest airport in the Netherlands. Passion and dedication are central to this series and everything revolves around the safe and efficient flow of passenger traffic.

name: Ceux qui rougissent
summary: Around ten high school students studying theatre see a replacement teacher arrive for a month. As they declaim Shakespeare while keeping their distance, the teacher cuts the rehearsal short. At the heart of an age where we often advance masked, our gaze too high or our heads too lowered, the question of the intimate imposes itself on them.

previousepisode.name: La Méditerranée au cœur du dérèglement climatique

name: Miseinen ~Mijukuna Oretachi wa Bukiyo ni Shinkochu~
summary: Minase Jin, a top student who is indifferent to others, has been living his school life avoiding any interaction with Hirukawa Haruki, a reckless troublemaker in their class. However, one day, Minase accidentally witnesses Hirukawa outside of school, covered in bruises after being beaten by his father. Unintentionally learning this secret, Minase tries to distance himself, not wanting to get involved any further. But he can't get the image of the Hirukawa he saw, so different from the one at school, out of his mind…As the two begin to discover sides of each other that they never saw at school, new feelings start to blossom, feelings that neither of them had ever experienced before.

previousepisode.name: Part One: The Road We Walk Together // Part Two: Dawn

name: Tickets for the Titanic
summary: Black comedies looking at a 'sinking' Britain in the 80s.

name: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
summary: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking invites fans to mix, whisk and glaze their way to success, with professional pastry chefs competing against each other to create enchanting sweet treats, themed around the Harry Potter stories. Will the bakers be able to channel their inner Mrs Weasley? Or will their attempts be as successful as one of Seamus Finnigan's exploding cauldrons?

name: Informant – Angst über der Stadt
summary: Evidence of an impending attack in Hamburg puts the police authorities on alert. The focus is on the aging LKA man Gabriel Bach and the young BKA officer Holly Valentin. Out of necessity, they recruit the Afghan substitute teacher Raza Shaheen as an informant, who has previously had absolutely nothing to do with terrorism or organized crime. Under enormous time pressure, they work to save lives in the midst of a maelstrom of fear, prejudice and hysteria - and in doing so put themselves in great danger.

name: Como Agua para Chocolate
summary: Como Agua para Chocolate explores the idea that sometimes traditions can become a prison, an obstacle for love. Tita de la Garza and Pedro Múzquiz are two souls deeply in love, yet unable to be together due to entrenched family customs. The protagonists navigate a world of magical realism and rich flavors as Tita struggles between the destiny imposed on her by her family and her fight for love. Along the way, the audience will witness her greatest refuge: the kitchen. For Tita, her magical connection to cooking becomes an active resistance against oppression, allowing her to channel her deepest desires and passions into her recipes, transforming those who taste them.

name: Lost Monster Files
summary: Lost Monster Files features a team of experts who gained exclusive access to Sanderson's detailed research and will use it to reinvestigate his most prominent unfinished cases. The team will focus on present day sightings such as the Abominable Snowman and Chupacabra to determine if modern science and technology can bring them closer to answers for these mysterious creatures.

name: Theatre Box
summary: Six individual plays for children.

name: Bait Hook
summary: Cheng Yu, a kept woman with a rebellious spirit, struggles to break free from Zhou Jin's control. In a staged "infidelity incident," she meets Pei Zheng, a "male model." Cheng Yu repeatedly provokes Pei Zheng, giving him opportunities to "rescue" her. From feigned indifference to calculated advances, the two initially use each other but gradually develop genuine feelings.

name: The Unbreakable Bond
summary: The story follows Ling Chuxia, a young girl trapped in a difficult situation, who bravely defies family constraints and societal criticism. She forms a bond with the male lead, Liang Junye, who shares her struggles. Together, they support each other, overcome their life challenges, and join forces to uncover an evil conspiracy by a foreign tribe, ultimately protecting their homeland.

name: Good American Family
summary: Told from multiple points of view, as a means to explore issues of perspective, bias, and trauma, this compelling drama is inspired by the disturbing stories surrounding a Midwestern couple who adopts a girl with a rare form of dwarfism. But as they begin to raise her alongside their three biological children, mystery emerges around her age and background, and they slowly start to suspect she may not be who she says she is. As they defend their family from the daughter they've grown to believe is a threat, she fights her own battle to confront her past and what her future holds, in a showdown that ultimately plays out in the tabloids and the courtroom.

name: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, But I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
summary: Alina thought she had found the perfect job as a guild receptionist. It's stable, safe, and has a super cute uniform. But this dream gig turns into an overtime nightmare whenever adventurers get stuck clearing a dungeon. Tired of the long nights, Alina starts taking down the bosses herself! She even earns the name Executioner for her impressive skills. Can she keep her identity a secret?

previousepisode.name: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, But I'll Fight to the Bitter End to Get Out of Working Overtime

name: To Be Hero X
summary: This is a world where heroes are created by people's trust, and the hero who has received the most trust is known as - X. In this world, people's trust can be calculated by data, and these values will be reflected on everyone's wrist. As long as enough trust points are obtained, ordinary people can also have superpowers and become superheroes that save the world. However, the ever-changing trust value makes the hero's path full of unknowns...

name: Dream Homes Revealed
summary: Set within the unique landscapes of Australia, this series uncovers the remarkable blend of architectural ingenuity and luxurious design that characterises Australian homes.

name: Ninja Warrior, le parcours des héros
Cuffy
summary: Cuffy is an impulsive doer of mischief, but something of a saint among the scoundrels in the tinkering fraternity.

name: Le Retour d'Anna Brodeur
summary: After 10 years of exile, Anna Brodeur is back in the lives of her loved ones, and finds reconnecting with her past a real challenge.

name: Ninja Warrior : Le Choc des Nations
Light of My Lion
summary: Komori Hiroto is a kind young man who works at the city hall. Since losing his parents in an accident, he has been living with his younger brother Michito, who has autism spectrum disorder. Their restful days are changed when they meet a young boy called "Lion" who they decide to take in. Before long, they get caught up in an incident that changes their lives completely.

name: The Truth Within
summary: The youngest forensic doctor in Licheng, Qi Sizhe, loses his girlfriend, Yu Fei, in a car accident. However, he soon uncovers a mysterious force behind the crash. Determined to find the truth, he joins the criminal investigation team in Hecheng, only to be caught in a series of bizarre, chilling cases. Victims long dead are wrapped in webs, and missing bodies appear preserved in formalin in the morgue. As he teams up with Zhu Qingyue and Han Feng, they break case after case. And the truth behind Yu Fei's death and the "Original Diamond" drug case begins to surface…

name: Dead Ernest
summary: Comedy series in which Ernest Springer dies after being hit by a champagne cork and finds himself in the British section of heaven.

name: Farrington of the F.O.
summary: The British consul in a Latin American banana republic gets its first female Consul-General.

name: Doctors' Daughters
summary: Three ageing GPs are horrified to discover they are being replaced with sexy young female doctors.

name: Timber Wolf
summary: Timber Wolf follows the exploits of one Thomas T. Wolf, who is trying to go one day without a tree falling on his head. It also chronicles his interactions with other woodland creatures, particularly his nemesis, Earl Squirrel.

name: Mistletoe Murders
summary: Emily Lane is a good-natured Christmas shop owner with a secret past. When local murders begin to pop up in Fletcher's Grove, Emily can't help but to use her unique talents from her past life to help solve murders that affect people in her new life. She crosses paths with Detective Sam Wilner who she starts to make a connection with, until he comes to learn there is more to Emily than meets the eye.

name: Unlock Your Love
summary: The pain and disappointment of love drives Rain and Love into each other's orbits. With the assistance of Dean and Pat, Love and Rain are able to get over the barrier erected by Rain's painful past.

name: MAFS UK: It's Official! With Chloe Burrows
summary: It's the official Married at First Sight UK podcast! Join us as we dissect all the drama and debate the juiciest goings-on.

name: Чик-Чирикино
summary: Chik-Chirikino is a town similar to a human one. But it is inhabited by birds, who, like people, go to work and school, travel by car and walk in parks. The town of birds is also home to a large sparrow family of Chirikins, the main characters of the animated series. The life of the noisy family is full of small adventures and comical situations that the sparrows get into thanks to their chicks. Animated stories about the cheerful everyday life of birds will appeal to any family with children! After all, you can find a little of yourself in each of the Chirikins.

name: Многогранники
summary: Masha, a girl from a simple family, studies at a prestigious university in the capital. And although she does not fit into the world of "golden youth", her best friend Dimka is one of them. When a student from England named Roman transfers to their group, this not only challenges Masha and Dimka's friendship, but also sets off a chain of events that will change the lives of many people forever.

name: Выжившие. Радио «Неделька»
summary: An unknown narrator stumbled upon a voice recorder and audio tapes in a bunker. Apparently, they were made a year and a half after the epidemic began. The virus affected the part of the brain responsible for sleep in the survivors. People lost the ability to wake up on their own. Those who slept for more than three hours did not wake up. The recordings were made over the course of a week by a man named Zhenya. The narrator believes that listening to these tapes may be useful to someone. In the recordings, Zhenya records his daily state. He communicates with the outside world using a radio station. Zhenya settled in the bunker of the bandits he killed. He is wounded and doubts that he will last long.

name: Шелковый путь
summary: A unique look at one of the oldest professions and cultures in the world. An observer-director travels with the circus, revealing to the viewer the joys, sorrows, adventures and realities of the sometimes harsh and sometimes touching life of a vagabond.

name: Laura and Disorder
summary: Recently divorced Laura Kingsley arrives home after ten years in California to find her beloved Britain much changed.

name: Pro Bull Riding Australia 2024
summary: NITV Sport presents the 2024 Pro Bull Riding series from across regional and metro Australia. Join us as this country's toughest cowboys compete to be named the 2024 National PBR champion.

name: Ffizz
summary: Upmarket wine merchants Mowbray & Crofts find times getting harder as a recession bites: the owners are forced to meet something called 'work'.

name: Father, Dear Father in Australia
summary: The hugely successful British television series Father Dear Father is transplanted to Australia when novelist Patrick Glover and his assistant Nanny trek down under to write the great Australian crime novel, and end up supervising Patricks boisterous young nieces while their own father is abroad.While Liz and Sue must learn to understand their conservative Uncle, Patrick must also adjust to a new life in Australia, with hilarious consequences.

name: Red Flag: Music's Failed Revolution
summary:
It's the new millennium and music is facing an existential threat: illegal piracy. In Red Flag: Music's Failed RevolutionWalkley Award-winning journalist Marc Fennell (The Kingdom, Framed, The Mission) uncovers the bizarre story of the Aussie start up, Guvera, that promised to revolutionise music forever, but instead vanished in a $180 million mystery. The two-part blackly comic docuseries premieres at 8.35pm Tuesday, 15 October on SBS and SBS On Demand.

Through exclusive interviews, never-before seen footage and photographs, incredible archive and dramatic reenactments, Red Flag: Music's Failed Revolution charts the spectacular rise and fall of Guvera – the Gold Coast tech start-up that challenged Spotify and was nicknamed the "iTunes Killer"- which once had A-list superstars like Alice Cooper and Mos Def lining up behind it with one mission: to destroy internet piracy.

In the 2 x 1 hour docuseries, Marc is joined by iconic Australian musician Ben Lee as they take a nostalgic trip to the 90s, the golden age, before piracy threatened to take down the multi-billion-dollar music industry and an unlikely saviour. Guvera, emerged from the Gold Coast.

With an audacious plan to revolutionise the music industry by promising free, legal mp3 downloads (and later streaming), Guvera's colourful founders offered a beacon of hope in an era dominated by illegal file sharing platforms like Napster and Pirate Bay. In a few short years, Guvera would take the world by storm – becoming the main player in the music downloading and streaming market and beating Spotify to launch in key markets. With its superstar following, glitzy parties and lucrative brand sponsorships, including Harley Davidson and The Australian Open, it raised an eye watering $180 million, but what was really going on behind closed doors?

As Marc digs deeper, red flags start to emerge, uncovering a web of shady business dealings, ethical question marks, a company on the brink, and many lives left in its wake. With candid interviews with former Guvera staff, devastated investors, music industry experts, and behind the scenes footage, the documentary delves into the darker side of the start-up and a "fake-it-till-you-make-it" story so familiar with other famous tech start-ups, fuelled by the unwavering belief that one big idea can change the world.

name: Okutô kanjô sôsakan Shinno Akari
summary: Akari Shinno s a detective with a special ability. She is able to see the eight human emotions in color. Due to a case, she teams up with Detective Ryo Kazehaya. They work together to reveal the truth behind heinous crimes.

name: Feet First
summary: Until very recently, Terry Prince was a conduit joint insulation mechanic in the Midlands; he and wife Viv lived with his parents, and football was simply a game he enjoyed playing for the local team. But Terry's natural talent has come the attention of big-league manager Harry Turnbull, and he and Viv now find themselves trying to come to terms with a variety of novel tactics... both on and off the field!

name: That's Your Funeral
summary: Basil Bulstrode is pompous, grouchy and stubborn - he's also an undertaker who loves his work.

name: Art Detectives
summary:
Art Detectives is a compelling new original crime series centered around the Heritage Crime Unit, a police department consisting of art loving DI Mick Palmer and straight-talking DC Shazia Malik. Together, they solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques, from Old Master paintings, to Banksy street art, medieval manuscripts and collectible vinyl.

Throughout the season, the artfully astute detectives encounter a fake Vermeer, Viking gold, a rare Chinese vase and items rescued from the Titanic. It's a rich and colorful world driven by greed, obsession, lust and revenge. Mick navigates these demanding cases while managing a budding romance with museum curator Rosa and the sudden reappearance of his charismatic father, Ron, who just happens to be one of Britain's most notorious forgers.

name: Вера
summary: Many years ago, a tragedy occurred in Vera's family - an unknown person kidnapped her little daughter Katya and demanded a ransom, but had no intention of returning the baby alive. Since then, the woman has not been able to recover - she celebrates her daughter's birthday every year, and even created a photo with the help of artificial intelligence of what Katya would look like now, at 18 years old. Pyotr, Vera's husband, considers all this a meaningless ritual, and for a long time now he and his wife have only been connected by their common business. Despite everything, Vera hopes for a miracle that will return her Katya, and suddenly she sees a girl on the street who seems to have stepped out of that very photo.

name: Karşılaşmalar
summary: The series brings together encounters in daily life that are considered "too much" with different guests.

name: Tătuțu
summary: About 20 years before Clanul, Bebe Udrea (George Mihaita), aka "Macelaru" (The Butcher), aimed to build his own clan and rise to the top of the mafia. The series reveals his dangerous journey and the origins of beloved Clanul characters.

name: Выбор сердца
summary: Катя Соколова — врач-реаниматолог больницы. Впереди у нее долгожданная свадьба и рождение ребенка. Но однажды ее будущему угрожает несчастный случай. Вернувшись домой, Катя вступается за девушку, которую избивает мужчина, и сама получает травму. Она теряет ребенка, жених отменяет свадьбу и уезжает. Катя пишет заявление в полицию, но дело затягивается. Спустя год @Катя влюбляется в бизнесмена Михаила Власова. Кажется, она наконец-то нашла свое предназначение... Михаил знакомит Катю со своей семьей — отцом и младшим братом Иваном, в котором Катя узнает человека, искалечившего ее жизнь. Теперь Катя намерена довести начатое до конца и добиться справедливости, чего бы это ей ни стоило.

name: Три любимые женщины
summary: Dasha, Katya and Lidia Petrovna are completely unknown women. They are united only by a recently deceased businessman – father, husband and son. After his death, the women turn out to be heirs to a common cause and common debts. Now three women, different in character, age and social status, who also can't stand each other, are forced to unite.

name: Тайный дневник моей сестры
summary:
Marina has been married to Gosha for 14 years, they got married right after graduation. Recently, there has been a crisis in their relationship: it was not the first time Marina had a miscarriage at an early stage, Gosha threw himself into work. Marina began to wonder if such a family life was suitable for her... Moreover, before her eyes is the example of her older sister Lyuba, whose personal life was a success.
Soon the news comes that Lyuba has died. Marina can't believe the accident. She finds her sister's childhood diary and in it notes made recently. It turns out that the exemplary Lyuba was unhappy and lonely for a long time. What happened to my sister? Who is to blame for her death? Marina decides to conduct her own investigation.

name: Адвокат для сбежавшего жениха
summary:
Successful lawyer Anna Kalinina is going to marry designer Nikita, with whom she is expecting a child. But literally on the threshold of the registry office, the groom leaves her, exchanging her for another. Anya plunges headlong into her work, and suddenly she gets the case ... of her ex, who is accused of murdering a nanny in the house of businessman Alexander Sobolev. Nikita's mother begs Anna to help her son, because he is the father of her child.
Convinced of Nikita's innocence, Anna goes to the village where the crime was committed and meets Sobolev and his little daughter Katya. At first, the relationship between Anna and Sobolev does not work out, the businessman is not eager to help the criminal's lawyer. But still they manage to get on the trail of the real culprit of what happened. Gradually, sympathy arises between Sobolev and Anna, which develops into a serious feeling…

name: Блонды
summary: The series "Blondes" will tell about the work of a secret special department for solving especially complex crimes in St. Petersburg. The agents have an extremely unusual cover - their office exists under the guise of the "Blondes" marriage agency. The department is supervised by an experienced investigator Smolov, who has gathered three completely different girls under his wing. This is a former employee of the Investigative Committee - rational Kiseleva, a bright and daring lover of horoscopes and men Gorskaya and uncompromising Boyko, a master of martial arts. Together they will have to not only catch offenders, but also learn to work in a team.

name: Another Journey to the West
summary: Wu Cheng'en vividly depicts a world full of fantasies and myths in his 16th-century novel Journey to the West. Some say his portrayal was not mere fiction, but drawn from personal experience. Join him and his companions on a legendary pilgrimage to the "Western Regions" as they seek their path of Enlightenment after many trials and suffering.

name: My Merry Marriage
summary: By showing various aspects of marriage such as divorce, remarriage, and graduation, it asks about the true meaning of 'happiness'. A delightful family drama that will resonate and laughter across all generations.

name: Clutch: The NBA Playoffs
summary: Clutch: The NBA Playoffs offers an in-depth look at the 2024 NBA Playoffs, where the league's brightest stars and most determined veterans battle for supremacy. The series delves into the high-stakes action both on and off the court, chronicling the personal and professional journeys of players like Zion Williamson, Tyrese Maxey, Jalen Brunson, Tyrese Haliburton, P.J. Washington, and Jaylen Brown as they navigate the challenges of postseason basketball. With exclusive access, Clutch captures defining moments that shape not just games, but legacies showcasing the NBA's next generation of leaders.

name: Constructing Australia
summary: Politics, tragedy and conquest combine in stories behind the building of Australia. The Bridge, Pipe Dreams and A Wire Through the Heart combine rare archival images with dramatic storytelling in showcasing three landmark events that would allow Australia to mark its place in the world. The Sydney Harbour Bridge, the Kalgoorlie Pipeline and the Overland Telegraph line were engineering triumphs, but the human drama in constructing Australia is even more fascinating.

name: Jake Makes It Easy
summary: Jake Makes It Easy provides viewers a step-by-step process for creating a main course and dessert that incorporate aspects from classic dishes and unique flavors all while keeping it simple. Having worked in some of New York City's top restaurants and test kitchens, Jake brings his impressive culinary background and love of hosting to create inspired meals fit for any table. With dishes including everything from balsamic and soy brisket, challah monkey bread, and Iraqi salmon to date brownies, baked gnocchi and soup-less chicken soup, Jake weaves together his heritage and stories of food and family to create unforgettable meals every guest will love.

previousepisode.name: Cheeseburger Arayes & Raspberry Goat Cheese Bars

name: Fire Crackers
summary: Sitcom set in a quiet fire station which serves a small community with its 60-year-old fire engine Bessie.

name: La Voz de la Mañana
summary: Perfect combination of breaking news, current affairs and popular culture trends.

name: Haggard
summary: In an effort to bolster their pockets, Squire Haggard and his unscrupulous son, Roderick strut across the English countryside desperately searching for an heiress willing to part with her money, a man whose talent at the gambling table does not match his view of himself, or any manner of other scheme that may amuse and offer financial recompense for as little effort as is possible.

name: Reggaeton: The Sound that Conquered the World
summary: Reggaeton: The Sound that Conquered the World dives into the genre's origins to becoming a cultural and commercial powerhouse in the global music industry through the eyes of pivotal Reggaeton figures.

name: All Star Workouts
summary: This instructional series teaches new routines, exercises, and styles. Whether it's yoga, weight training, aerobics, or martial arts, the objective is to tone and tighten.

name: Funny Man
summary: The mixed fortunes of an extended family of music-hall entertainers in search of their big break.

name: Hark at Barker
summary: The dogmatic Lord Rustless finds his stately posture frustrated by his uncontrollable staff as he attempts to lecture on a series of topics.

name: High & Dry
summary: Ron Archer and son Trevor set out to buy and rennovate the more-than-a-little dilapidated pier at Midbourne.

name: Blossoms in Dream
summary: The girl Xian was raised by Hui, a single mother who runs a photo studio. By chance, Xian followed her lover Cong to the studio, which attracted the attention of boss Meng of the film company, and her life's destiny changed. Boss Meng took advantage of Xian's purity and yearning for an actor's identity to give her the glory of a star and emotional dreams. Later, in order to protect himself during the war, he abandoned Xian, who was already pregnant. Mother Hui also passed away sadly because she could not bear the betrayal of her emotional support Lao Wang. The nostalgia for her daughter Zhi has become Xian's only hope for survival. Time flies, Zhi has grown up, and she falls in love with her classmate Zou Jie, who also works in the shipyard. Due to their background, the love of this young couple was hindered. However, the two people who pursued progress still walked firmly together. Xian, who has reached middle age, reunites with her long-lost former lover Cong, and they renew their relationship and love each other for the rest of their lives. The life situation full of joys and sorrows finally cleared up all the misunderstandings caused by the collision of ideas between the two generations, and the mother and daughter ushered in their own beautiful lives together.

name: Every You, Every Me
summary: On a rainy night, Sun tries to sell umbrellas at a bus stop, where he meets Dol, an office worker who seems to be uninterested in him. But this doesn't stop Sun from pursuing Dol, and eventually Sun learns of Dol's secret. Will these two come together despite their differences and become soulmates?

name: See Your Love
summary: Yang Zi Xiang is sent to Taiwan for business negotiations but gets attacked. He hires Jiang Shao Peng to take care of him and takes this opportunity to escape from his family responsibility while also falling for Shao Peng. Zi Xiang's assistant, Feng Jie, acts as a stand-in for his boss, and Xin Jia, the assassin hired to get rid of Zi Xiang, repeatedly fails to take out his target. While Feng Jie manages to escape, sparks of love start to bloom.

name: The Beauty
summary: When international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways, two FBI agents are sent to Paris, Venice, Rome and New York to uncover the truth behind these deaths and end up discovering a conspiracy that threatens the future of humanity.

name: Забытая любовь
summary:
A difficult period is coming in the relationship between architects Nadezhda and Andrey – financial instability, work problems, Andrey's sick mother, whose care requires money, as well as unsuccessful attempts to have a child.
Adding fuel to the fire is the arrival of their successful classmate Kirill, Nadia's ex-boyfriend, who comes to their town to build a large shopping center. Kirill makes a tempting offer to the couple: Nadia – to head the company leading the construction, and Andrey – to become the chief designer of his project. They agree, unaware that Kirill has a plan for them: he is going to take revenge on Nadia, who 15 years ago chose another.

name: На грани
summary: "On the Edge" is a show that will definitely make you want to delve deeper into science. Host Yulia Gavrilina and her co-host Dima Pobedinsky will conduct shocking experiments and demonstrate how the laws of physics work.

name: Crimewatch Caught
summary: Crimewatch Caught is set to reveal the inner workings of how detectives investigated and solved a range of complex crimes. Each episode will feature exclusive interviews with leading officers, alongside the crucial CCTV, forensic evidence and witness testimony that allowed them to bring the perpetrators to justice.

name: Dino Dex
summary: Dex is a 9-year-old artist, explorer, and ‘paleontologist in training'. Like Dan, Trek, and Dana before him, Dex uses his Dino Field Guide to magically see and study dinosaurs in the real world. But Dex envisions them a little differently. Thanks to his artistic eye, Dex wants to reconsider how dinosaurs looked and lived and he's not afraid to get right into the action to do it. Fortunately, he's got his geology-loving neighbor Kayla along for this prehistoric ride. Join Dex and Kayla as they re-examine and question everything we thought we knew about dinosaurs.

name: Bunkerkvinnan
summary: Isabel Eriksson was drugged and kidnapped - and then locked in a bunker. A terrifying incident that has plagued and haunted her for almost ten years. In the documentary Bunkerkvinnan, she tells her story.

name: Veil of Revenge
summary: When Li Zhiren was waiting for his girlfriend Zhang Lulu, he was attracted by a mysterious girl named Chen Yueran. He was shocked to find that she was the representative of his partner and was gradually entering his life. However, the truth was more astonishing. Chen Yueran was his dead ex-wife who came back in a different name only for revenge. She managed to reveal Zhang Lulu's secrets step by step and turned her against Li Zhiren. In the end, they worked together to send Li Zhiren to jail. In the meantime, Chen Yueran and a forceful man Gao Lingyu started to have feelings for each other. A game of revenge and love has begun.

name: Schlaue Schwärme
summary:
Swarms – whether insects, animals, birds, or even humans – are powerful and complex coordinated actions between individuals, working together to benefit the community. Some see a higher intelligence in a swarm, while others doubt the wisdom of crowds. Swarm behaviour has even been equated with herd stupidity. 

In this two-part documentary, internationally renowned scientists and experts from diverse research fields dispel prejudices and show the intelligence of swarms. Using fascinating high-speed recordings and thermal images of various natural swarms, the researchers attempt to break down swarm codes, explain strange collective behaviour, and explore how we can learn from nature to bring about astounding technological advances. 

This series aims to help viewers understand the intelli- gence and organised chaos of swarms, even as they are mesmerised by the swarms' astonishing beauty.

name: The Killer Nurse
summary: Known as 'The Angel of Death' Beverley Allitt was responsible for the murder of 4 children, attempted murder of 3 more and grievous bodily harm of 6 others, all whilst employed in the role of a nurse on a children's ward in Lincolnshire. A Nurse is the last person you'd expect to turn out to be a serial killer.

name: Twisted Twins
summary: Explore the intense and sometimes deadly relationship between twins. How does a closeness generally seen as positive thing turn into something much darker?

name: Touch Ups with Raven
summary: It's Raven, hunty - at RuPaul's DragCon! The number one place to meet your favorite queens. Each week, Raven will kiki with Drag Race queens to touch up and talk sh*t.

name: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
summary: It's the year 2020, and Mizuho is having the worst 17th birthday ever. Her parents forgot it's her birthday, she still can't seem to get close to the senior she likes, and all her school trips and tournaments are canceled thanks to a new disease going around. She's convinced she'll never have the kind of youth she's always dreamt of…until her childhood friend, Kizuki, suddenly asks her out.

previousepisode.name: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.

name: The Fragrance You Inherit
summary: "My beloved Mone married a man I didn't know." On the worst day of her life, 20-year-old Sakura Hirose received her greatest treasure that very same day. Fifteen years later, her precious son Toki became a high school student, and the two of them lived simple but happy days together. One day, Toki brings home his girlfriend, Kanae, who looks just like Sakura's beloved Mone and even carries the scent of golden olive, which holds memories for both of them…!? The peaceful days of this parent and child begin to slowly change. From Sakura to Toki, what will become of the love that has been passed down through two generations…!?

name: Mighty Machines
summary: Mighty Machines focuses on footage of real machines (firetrucks, airplanes, freight trains, snow plows) working. Voiceovers tell the story of how the machines work together to get work done.

name: Off Campus
summary: Off Campus follows the unlikely romance between wry, hockey-hating music major Hannah Wells and Briar U's womanizing star center Garrett Graham as they strike a deal to help each other out. But will their deal unfold as expected?

name: Cartoon Monsoon
summary: Cartoon Monsoon is an Adobe Flash anthology webseries created by Warner Bros. Animation as the last of their many experiments with internet animation during the early 2000s.

name: The Game of Queen Bee
summary: A new survival reality show, The Game of Queen Bee, invites you to the world of queen bees and their males where they compete for the prize money of 100,000 dollars in wild environments. The six queen bees, Monika, Jang Eun Sil, Jeong He Jin, Seo Hyun Suk, Shin Ji Eun, and Gooseul, must each lead three male participants in extreme survival missions and physical fights amid suffocating psychological warfare. The queen bees must lead their team members wisely and efficiently using the strategies and tactics they come up with as a team in order to win.

name: LOL: Last One Laughing UK
summary: Famous for his dark humour, one-liners and THAT laugh, Jimmy Carr challenges 10 of Britain's funniest comics to spend the day together without so much as a titter. The rules are simple: laugh and you're out. Over the course of the series, they will use every ounce of their comedic talents to try and break their opponents - without cracking up themselves. And it's not just their rivals they need to watch out for. The series is packed with comedy cameos, format twists and surprises designed to lure laughs from both the players and the viewers. It's a stellar line up of British comedy talent as you've never seen them before, but who will be crowned the inaugural winner of Last One Laughing UK?

name: How's Your Father?
summary: Eddie Cropper is a middle-aged man struggling to come to terms with an ever-changing world, and to satisfy the demands of his family.

name: Promise of Wizard
summary: On a moonlit night, Akira Masaki finds herself in a magical world where wizards and humans coexist. Every year, they must face an enormous, deadly moon that attacks the planet. Their only hope lies with the Wizards of the Sage, appointed to fight the supernatural threat. But Akira soon discovers she wasn't summoned by chance—she was chosen to lead them in battle.

name: Re:Born
summary: A reality survival game for K-pop boy groups to debut in Japan.

name: Brewing Love
summary: Chae Yong-ju is a former member of the special forces in the military. She's physically and mentally strong and has her own unique cheerfulness. She is also good at hiding her true emotions. Now working as a salesperson for a liquor company for the past six years, she has been dubbed the sales king. Despite her dedication, her branch is on the verge of closing. To avoid the closure, she carries out a mission to sell a new beer made by brewmaster & CEO of the brewery company, Yun Min-ju. Min-ju is a sensitive man good at sensing other people's emotions. He lives in a peaceful, quiet rural area to focus on making beer. When Yong-ju appears in front of him, however, his life is about to change.

name: SCOOL
summary: SCOOL follows the story of 40 contestants who will participate in a series of missions for a chance to debut in a global K-Pop boy group. The show will take place in both Korea and Taiwan. 7 winners will be selected to form a project boy group.

name: Jardins Proibidos
summary: The soap opera portrays the relationship between Teresa and Vasco, whose lives intersect due to a past full of mysteries.

previousepisode.name: That's What the World Calls Love

name: Gulliver in Lilliput
summary: Gulliver washes ashore on Lilliput and attempts to prevent war between that tiny kingdom and its equally minuscule rival Blefuscu.

name: Project 7
summary: Project 7 is an 'assembly, strengthening' audition program that breaks away from the audition format in which viewers mainly participated by voting, directly selecting participants for each round from the first round, forming a new team, and growing their favorite participants through the process. It is a differentiated new concept idol audition program that introduces the concept of "Project 7", a new concept idol assembly reinforcement audition scheduled to be aired on JTBC in October, is open to all 'men who dream of becoming top-tier idols' without restrictions on affiliation, experience, age, nationality, etc.

name: El secreto del río
summary: When a young boy arrives in a small Mexican village, an unlikely friendship blossoms with a local kid — and a dark secret seals their bond forever.

name: Australia's Most Dangerous Prisoners
summary:
In Australia, there are over 40,000 men and women currently behind bars. Many of them have done very bad things. They have shattered countless lives, destroyed families and been responsible for unspeakable criminal acts.

What did they do? How did they get here? And what are their lives like now?

This new series, Australia's Most Dangerous Prisoners, will outline in detail the crimes that landed these men and women in Australia's high-security jails through first-hand accounts by ex-inmates, former correctional officers, journalists and forensic psychologists, who try to make sense of their world.

name: Good Boy
summary: A comical action youth investigative drama in which medalists who became police officers as special recruits from the Olympics wear police ID cards around their necks instead of medals and fight against a world rife with unscrupulousness and foul play.

name: The Edge with Micah Parsons
summary: 2x Pro-Bowler Micah Parsons is one of the most knowledgeable and opinionated players in the NFL. From week-to-week, fans get the unique opportunity to hear the Dallas Cowboys star edge rusher dive into the biggest headlines, debate the hottest takes and more from around every corner of the league.

previousepisode.name: Micah Parsons on Ankle Injury, State of Cowboys & Reacts to Week 4 with Darius Slay | Week 4

name: People's Police
summary: Sixteen years ago, Detective Xia Hui led Zhao Haiyang and Fang Cheng in the pursuit of a murderer responsible for a family massacre. Due to Zhao Haiyang's youthful impulsiveness, Xia Hui tragically lost his life. Sixteen years later, burdened with regret and a deep hatred for criminals, Zhao Haiyang has become the Deputy Director of the Dongzhou City Public Security Bureau, while Fang Cheng has become a technical expert. Dongzhou City faces new challenges from emerging crimes. Utilizing advanced technologies, Zhao Haiyang and Fang Cheng effectively combat crime. Police reforms and technological applications have left criminals with nowhere to hide. However, Zhao Haiyang's wife, An Ping, encounters an accident during a case and is demoted to a local police station. As Zhao Haiyang and Fang Cheng are determined to track down the real murderer behind the massacre case from sixteen years ago, they uncover a powerful force working behind the scenes, with all clues pointing towards Zhao Haiyang's former superior, Liu Guangsheng. The two join forces to reveal the truth and vow to bring the true culprit to justice.

name: Big Brother
summary: Big Brother is hosted by Cláudio Ramos. The most watched house in the country welcomes a group of contestants, who fight for a prize of 100 thousand euros. Follow the challenges, intrigues and relationships of the contestants.

name: Tales From The Void
summary:
Tales From The Void is an episodic horror anthology series adapted from the most viral and haunting stories from the depths of the internet. Based on stories from the r/NoSleep community, each tale blends genre thrills with social commentary to explore the darker side of the human psyche.

From creepy dolls to unborn children, unexplained invasions to paranormal hauntings, unsolved mysteries to serial murders, Tales From The Void draws from a wide spectrum of horror sub-genres with each episode paying homage to a classic and cult films from the eighties and nineties.

Unnerving, uncompromising, and rooted in character, Tales From The Void finds all the ways to keep you up at night.

name: MasterChef Portugal
summary: The biggest cooking competition in the world kicks off under the command of three of the most renowned Portuguese chefs to discover the best amateur chefs in the country. After a casting process, the MasterChef Portugal hopefuls will begin a series of weeks of competition, with challenges in the studio and grandiose tests in such special and emblematic locations of our country, our history and our traditions.

name: Buy to Build
summary:
Every year in Australia, over 200,000 people buy a new home off the plans and a piece of land to build on. The property market is constantly changing, so how do you make the right decision when it comes to choosing a dream home to build from scratch? That's where Walt Collins steps in!

Each week, a couple of house hunters join Walt to view three shortlisted properties based on their budget, wants and needs. We follow their journey and weigh up the pros and cons of each display home. At the end of the episode, the couple will choose which one they will Buy to Build.

Plus, Walt takes a look at what the latest land releases are and how new communities are helping to shape the future of the country.

name: Thunderjacks
summary: In Thunderjacks, a famous former golf prodigy, who vanished into anonymity after a very public meltdown, is dragged into the limelight a decade later, forcing his dysfunctional family to futilely scramble to save their opulent lifestyle and fragile egos.

name: The Charlie Puth Show
summary: With the help of famous friends, Charlie Puth attempts to scale the zeitgeist and go beyond pop stardom to become a multi-hyphenate talent after being told it's no longer enough to just be a musician.

name: Apple My Love
summary: After getting her vision back, Kris sees a person in her dreams, but when she wakes up, the only thing she can remember are a pair of eyes. She starts drawing them to help her remember, but when she sees Karn for the first time, she recognizes that the pair in her dreams and Karn's are one and the same.

name: I'm Not a Monster: The Lois Riess Murders
summary: In 2018, a small-town murder in Minnesota shocks a community when 56-year-old wife, mother, and grandmother Lois Riess kills her husband David and goes on the run from the authorities. Years later, Lois sits down with the filmmakers telling her story for the first time. Lois herself attempts to explain her reprehensible actions which reveals a disturbing family history and an addiction to gambling.

name: Reality with the King: Huntsville Edition
summary: Carlos King brings his insider knowledge and hilarious banter in "Reality with the King: Huntsville Edition," as we look back at episodes from the past season of "Love & Marriage: Huntsville." In each episode, King will have a special Huntsville guest to interview, and then sit back and review the episode together, spilling tea the whole way through.

previousepisode.name: Reality with the King: Marsau & Carlos

name: An Out-of-this-World Romance
summary: Li Qin Nan entered the world of novels and became Qiu Yu Ke, the daughter of Qiu Wen Shan, the minister of rituals, and was given in marriage to Ming Jing Chuan, a national teacher who was admired by all. As a result, Qiu Yu Ke, who never believed in love, and Ming Jing Chuan, who didn't know what it was, went from initial suspicion and disgust to later trust and love, and finally achieved personal growth and understood the true meaning of love.

name: Taking One for the Team
summary: In Taking One for the Team, Shumpert delves into the sacrifices athletes make for their teams, turning seemingly mortifying moments into hilarious stories. Through personal narratives, comedic animations, and heartfelt testimonials, each episode explores the emotional depth of team dedication.

name: Les Traîtres, nouvelle génération
summary: At the heart of this adventure, seasoned players will find themselves confronted with unexpected situations, forcing them to reveal unsuspected aspects of their personality. The challenge? Navigate a universe where friendship, betrayal and strategy violently collide.

name: Conversations au coeur du pouvoir : Les maîtres du Reich
summary: Thanks to a precise work of deciphering the lips, this documentary series makes it possible to discover what Adolf Hitler and the senior Nazi dignitaries really said to each other when they thought they were inaudible.

name: It Takes a Worried Man
summary: Philip Roath is a middle-aged and divorced office worker who is highly intelligent, but suffering a midlife crisis, and completely bored with his job. He is never seen doing any actual work, just conversing with his colleagues about his boredom and frustrations with life. His boss suspects that Philip does little work, but is powerless to prove it or to do anything about it. Philip is also seen in psychoanalysis sessions with his analyst, Simon, who has worse emotional issues than Philip does.

name: Kindly Leave the Kerb
summary: Kindly Leave the Kerb is a 1971 British television sitcom which aired on ITV. It features Peter Butterworth as a second-rate escapologist, who busks around the streets of London with his companion played by Peter Jones. The show was scripted by the writing team of Johnnie Mortimer and Brian Cooke.

name: The Incredible Mr Tanner
summary: Ernest Tanner is a bumbling, accident-prone man who is perhaps the worst escapologist in the world.

name: Kalpazan
summary: Adem turns his life upside down with a surprise he makes for his son, Arda. What seems like an innocent gesture leads to an irreversible downfall in Adem's life, bringing him to the brink of losing his job, his wife Canan, and even his son. Things take a further turn for the worse with the arrival of his charismatic yet cunning brother, Kartal, during this difficult period. As the two brothers challenge the law, the only person who can bring about their downfall is Police Officer Ayşe. Kartal's unexpected encounter with Ayşe and his subsequent love for her will shift the balance entirely.

name: Great Australian Concerts
summary: Mark Lizotte revisits some of Australia's greatest, most loved concerts, exploring the intriguing stories behind them and what made each show so special.

name: Sahipsizler
