summary: The struggle of 6 orphan siblings living in Istanbul to survive and their solidarity in the face of adversity.

name: Las abogadas
summary: The story of 20-year-old lawyer Lola González Ruiz and her group of friends who challenged the Francoist dictatorship with the law at hand, from 1969 up to the Atocha killings in 1977.

name: Fugitives: Caught on Tape
summary: "Fugitives Caught on Tape" follows law enforcement officers as they pursue fugitives on the run. With unprecedented access to a multitude of cameras including body and dash cams, security and traffic cams, personal doorbell footage, smartphone cams and more, viewers get a look at how agencies track down fleeing suspects.

name: Life and Dirt
summary: A man's desire to make it quick leads him to a race against time to preserve his life while hiding his dirt.

name: Uncle Unknown
summary: The story of the Lu family's young master, Lu Shi Ran, who reunited with his missing ex-boyfriend, Qi Yi. Lu Shi Ran discovers that Qi Yi is actually "the uncle" (no blood relation) he had never met! As Qi Yi keeps pursuing Lu Shi Ran, Lu Shi Ran keeps retreating. How can the two break the taboo and reunite with each other?

previousepisode.name: Happy proposal! "A family is formed with the people you love."

name: Elements of Disaster
summary: The conditions of ‘The Great Southern Land' are perfect for disasters, and across the last fifty years, Australia has witnessed a multitude of devastating events.

name: Lucan
summary:
Lucan follows one man's hunt for the truth about the murder of Sandra Rivett.

On November 7, 1974, the dead body of a children's nanny, Sandra Rivett, was discovered in a mail sack in the basement of a Belgravia townhouse. The chief suspect was the father of the children, an Eton educated gambler called Richard John Bingham, the seventh earl of Lucan, who had disappeared. While most of Lord Lucan's friends and family insisted that he had taken his own life, no body has ever been found. The manhunt for Lucan has lasted decades.

This series follows the deeply personal quest of Hampshire builder, Neil Berriman, whose conviction in his own ability to solve the mystery is unshakeable. The case has consumed Neil for the last two decades, and it has done so for very personal reasons: Neil's birth mother was Sandra Rivett.

name: Intrepid Adventures
summary: Get ready for an exhilarating adventure with Intrepid Adventures, where we dive into the heart of the world's most captivating destinations.

previousepisode.name: ... On Arrivals And Departures And Things In Between

name: Mat na Maitice
summary:
"Mat na Maitice" is designed to make everyday mathematical concepts accessible and engaging for young audiences. The series will focus on fundamental topics such as counting, sequences, shapes, patterns, measurements, and equalities. By presenting these concepts through relatable characters and real-life scenarios, the twelve-episode series aims to help children overcome common challenges and develop a love for mathematics.

Each episode begins with a short title sequence introducing Mat, a ten-year-old boy who struggles with maths. Each programme finds Mat initially baffled by a maths conundrum, but with the help of his younger sister, Siún, who happens to be a maths genius, he discovers the answer. The learning objectives of the programme are then introduced before the audience embarks on a learning journey with Mat and Siún. The audience will see Mat spending time with friends, family, and other characters who help him solve mathematical problems in fun, everyday scenarios.

Viewers will solve the problem alongside Mat, with the timing of the short dramas allowing children to work out the answer and feel accomplished. At the end of each video, Mat will be praised by his parents for his efforts, while his sister seethes, and he will thank the viewers for their help.

To enhance the learning experience, vibrant and fun graphics such as thought bubbles, clocks, cartoon question marks, and floating numbers are used intermittently. These graphics will help children understand Mat's internal thoughts and assist them in solving the maths conundrums, adding a fun aesthetic learning  element to each film. At the end of each episode, Mat addresses the viewers, thanking them for their help in solving the problem.

Each episode concludes with a graphic sequence presenting a similar conundrum for the viewers to solve on their own. The graphics vary depending on the subject matter and serve to reinforce the learning objective, with Mat voicing the question and offering encouragement, such as "Well done" or "Thanks for your help."

The series consists of 12 five-minute dramatized live-action videos featuring two young leading actors and their on-screen parents. Clean Slate TV cast a family of actors and friends who help Mat as he tries to solve everyday maths problems.

"Mat na Maitice" is an engaging and educational series that will make mathematics fun and accessible for young children and we look forward to inspiring a new generation of maths enthusiasts at home and at school.

name: Solar System
summary: Diamond rain, supersized volcanoes, exploding oceans - and we have a front row seat for it all. Professor Brian Cox reveals the strange worlds visible to us as never before.

name: Jamie: Fast and Simple
summary: Want to make deliciously simple meals, and fast? Jamie Oliver's got us covered, as he strips back cooking to its essentials and shows us some innovative ways to speed up our time in the kitchen.

name: Secret Amazon: Into the Wild
summary: British explorer Lucy Shepherd and an Indigenous team embark on an unprecedented Amazon expedition, crossing virgin jungle territory while facing extreme danger at every turn.

name: Warau Shukujo
summary:
Nonomiya Kyoko reunites with her relative Gamo Michiru after many years of separation. In the past, the two shared a deadly secret while still at school. For the past 17 years, Kyoko has been avoiding Michiru, but now it seems they are destined to meet.

Michiru takes over the company Kyoko works for, and she opens a counseling service for people who are having problems in life. Honor, wealth, ambition, unrequited love, etc. She ruthlessly manipulates the desires of those who come here and makes them fall into despair.

Kyoko, who is stuck in the position of Accomplice with Michiru, gradually worships that Evil Girl...What will be the fate of these two people linked by crime?

name: Bluebirds
summary: Children's drama about some children trying to make their estate a better place.

name: My Damn Business
summary: Sales Team 2 receives notification of dissolution amidst the company's management crisis. Left alone, Team Leader Han must wrap up business with partner companies that he has managed within three months. Yun, an assistant manager from the support team, is dispatched to Sales Team 2. With just the two of them in the empty office, Han can't help but notice Yun's aloof demeanor. A small incident leads to changes between the two.
